weeks.focus: Teen numbers as ten and ones

intro: This package contains all 26 completed weeks: each has 6 Math, 6 English, and 6 Science student worksheets plus 3 subject answer pages.
Each week includes a math story scene, a separate reading illustration, and a science illustration. Solutions follow the student worksheets at the end of that weekly PDF.
Every week contains 6 Math, 6 English, and 6 Science student pages plus 3 subject answer pages.
Math builds from hours and half hours to exact minutes and elapsed-time conversation; every week has clock reading, hand drawing, count-by-5, count-by-10, and pattern logic.
Each week has its own newly illustrated main story scene. Math answers show completed clock faces with the correct hand positions.
Every weekly PDF also includes precise printable student clocks and visual pattern models.
Each week: 6 Math + 6 English + 6 Science student pages, then 3 illustrated answer pages (21 pages).
26 unique two-panel illustrated settings; top panel for story and math, bottom panel for the science topic.
Daily clocks, including elapsed time, crossing the hour, exact hands and completed analog clock answers.
Skip counting, growing patterns, reading, writing, observation, predictions, evidence, and fair comparisons.
